With no type recorded the restriction is unreadable and the mana pays for nothing. Still not modelled: "can't be countered" | CR 106.6, CR 614.12a |

## W14: eight activated abilities, and the subsystems they needed

A batch of previously-silent activated abilities, each reached only by building something the engine did not already have:

- **Basking Broodscale** - `{1}{G}: Adapt 1.` CR 701.46a's keyword *action* (not an ability), read off the ability's own text with no per-card row: `_parse_adapt_clause`. Its own third paragraph - the counter-placed Eldrazi Spawn trigger - is untouched and stays recorded above (`docs/engine-coverage.md`'s counter-placed-trigger row).
- **Wild Mongrel** - "Discard a card: This creature gets +1/+1 and becomes the color of your choice until end of turn." The colour is CR 608.2d's choice, not printed text, so `_parse_pump_and_becomes_chosen_color_clause` builds both `ContinuousEffect`s (layer 7c pump, layer 5 colour) by hand through `ContinuousEffects.add` rather than through the text-driven registry.
- **Mother of Runes** - "{T}: Target creature you control gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn." The same colour-choice gap the Modelled table's protection-grant row used to flag as unattempted; `_parse_protection_from_chosen_color_clause` grants a hand-built layer-6 "Protection from `<color>`" line, read by the existing `Game._effective_protection_qualities` on the damage side (CR 702.16e). The *targeting* side of a colour quality is enforced now too (CR 702.16b), so a red spell cannot be announced at a creature Mother has just protected from red - which is why the damage half is demonstrated with a non-targeting red source (Pyroclasm) rather than a Lightning Bolt.
- **Diamond City** - "{T}: Move a shield counter from this land onto target creature. Activate only if two or more creatures entered the battlefield under your control this turn." CR 122.5's "move" keyword action (`_parse_move_counter_clause`) plus a new activation-condition shape, `_ACTIVATE_ONLY_IF_ENTERED_THIS_TURN`, counting `CardState.turn_entered` the way `Game._activation_condition_holds` already counted two other "Activate only if" shapes.
- **The Darkness Crystal** - "{4}{B}{B}, {T}: Put target creature card exiled with The Darkness Crystal onto the battlefield tapped under your control with two additional +1/+1 counters on it." "Exiled with `<name>`" (CR 201.5 self-reference) is a real, checked target (CR 115.1), not a definite reference - `machines/targeting.TargetRequirement.exiled_with_source` is new, reusing `ExileMarker.IMPRINTED`/`ExileAnnotation.linked_permanent_id`. This card's *own* second paragraph (the exile-and-gain-life replacement effect) is still unbuilt - already recorded in the "Which replacement effects exist at all" row - so in a real game this target is never populated; the scenario test stages the link by hand, the same way `test_imprint.py` stages real exile state.
- **Mosswort Bridge** - Hideaway 4 plus "you may play the exiled card without paying its mana cost if [condition]". See the Modelled table's own Mosswort Bridge row and the "Keyword abilities with no execution path" row above.
- **Back from the Brink** - "Exile a creature card from your graveyard and pay its mana cost: Create a token that's a copy of that card." The mana owed depends on which card is chosen, known only once the cost is paid - `machines/cost.exile_and_pay_mana_cost_cost` and the new `CostComponent.pay_mana_cost_of_chosen` flag fold `ManaCost.parse(card.mana_cost)` into the activation's own cost once the choice is made (`Game.activation_cost` gained an `exiling=` parameter alongside `sacrificing=`/`discarding=`). "That card" in the effect is CR 607.1 anaphora, not a target - carried by a new `AbilityOnStack.cost_exiled_card_id` field, since there was previously no channel from a cost choice to a resolving effect at all.
- **Tamiyo, Compleated Sage** - `+1: Tap up to one target artifact or creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.` Read as one two-sentence ability (`_parse_tap_target_then_no_untap_clause`) rather than through the per-clause dispatcher, since the second sentence's "it" is anaphoric to the first's target. Reuses `CardState.exerted`/`.untap` - CR 701.43a's exert wording is functionally identical, just imposed by another permanent's ability rather than paid as a cost. `tests/scenarios/test_loyalty_abilities.py::test_a_targeted_loyalty_ability_announces_its_target` previously asserted the bears stayed untapped "because the effect half resolves as nothing" - that assertion documented the gap, not a rule, and is now updated to assert the tap actually happens.

Card-to-card exile linking (`ExileMarker.IMPRINTED`) turned out to generalise past "Imprint" itself: Hideaway (a different keyword) and The Darkness Crystal (no keyword at all, just "exiled with `<name>`" in plain text) both reuse the identical mechanism Ugin's Labyrinth introduced.

**That generalisation was on the *reading* side only** - `Game.card_imprinted_on`/`cards_imprinted_on` and `TargetRequirement.exiled_with_source` always happily read a link left by any writer - and it stayed that way until the Knowledge Pool session below: before it, exactly **two** clause parsers ever *wrote* the annotation at all (`_parse_imprint_clause`'s hand-exile shape, and the hideaway parser in `machines/keywords.py`). That session adds three more writers: the shared "each player exiles ..." closure in `_merge_each_player_clauses` (Knowledge Pool's own ETB, and Pyxis of Pandemonium's face-up cousin should one ever print), and Knowledge Pool's and Possibility Storm's own cast-and-exile ability, which self-links per CR 607.1c. See the Modelled table's Knowledge Pool/Possibility Storm row.

No `DecisionKind` was added - `CHOOSE_A_QUALITY` (already used for CR 614.12a's "as [this] enters, choose a color") is reused for Wild Mongrel's and Mother of Runes' "of your choice", and `CHOOSE_CARDS` for Hideaway's mandatory one-of-four exile. No new zone, no new `TriggerEvent`. The API-facing `DecisionKind` enum is unchanged - nothing here requires the sibling API repo to answer a new question shape.


## W15: the sweeper's last 25 silent cards

`scripts/sweep_pool.py`'s "cards that would do nothing at all if played right
now" bucket stood at **25 of 388**. It went to **0 of 387** at the time (the
denominator moved by one because Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx stopped having any
non-mana rules text at all - see below). Nothing was closed with a card-name
registry row: every fix is a parser reading the card's own printed text, so
the next card with the same shape is covered for free.

**That "0" is stale on two different axes, and neither is this section's own
work to close.** The pool has grown since (747 printings today against 388
here), and the sweep is not tracked as a standing zero anywhere between waves
- re-run it rather than trusting any number in this file, including this one.
Separately, and more to the point of this section: "0 silent" was never the
whole claim it read as. `--effects` classified a triggered ability as
`handled` from `trigger_effect_for` alone, without ever asking
`machines/triggers.condition_matches` whether the condition it fired on could
be satisfied by a real permanent - so a trigger that can never register at
all still counted as covered, right alongside a trigger that genuinely works.
That hole (and a second one, an effect matched out of a quoted span rather
than its own clause) is closed as of 2026-09-08 by two new buckets,
`unmatchable_condition` and `quoted_effect` - see "Finding the gaps" above for
what they measure and the current count.

Grouped by the mechanic each one needed, not by card:

- **Returning a card from a graveyard to the battlefield** (CR 110.2a's "put
  onto the battlefield", never a cast) - three shapes.
  `_parse_return_self_from_graveyard_to_battlefield_clause` reads "Return this
  card from your graveyard to the battlefield." (CR 700.7's self-reference,
  found by id wherever the card is, CR 113.7a) for **Arclight Phoenix**'s
  combat trigger and **Cauldron Familiar**'s `Sacrifice a Food:` ability.
  `_parse_mass_return_from_graveyard_to_battlefield_clause` reads **Raise the
  Past**'s whole-group return, with the group described by the new
  `_parse_card_group_qualifier` (below). `_parse_return_target_from_graveyard_
  gains_then_bounce` reads **Greasefang, Okiba Boss**'s three sentences as one
  CR 608.2c instruction - reanimate, grant a keyword with no stated duration
  (CR 611.2a leaves it indefinite, layer 6 per CR 613.1f), and create
  CR 603.7a's delayed trigger for the return at the controller's own next end
  step. `_parse_each_player_sacrifices_then_mass_reanimate` reads **Bringer of
  the Last Gift**'s pair, whose second sentence's candidate set is defined by
  what the first did ("that weren't put there this way"), so each graveyard is
  snapshotted before anything is sacrificed (CR 608.2f). **A fourth shape,
  closed 2026-09-09: the bare singular sentence itself had no reader at all.**
  "Return target `<quality>` card from your graveyard to the battlefield."
  with no self-reference, no "all", and no trailing decoration - the
  battlefield twin of `_RETURN_FROM_YOUR_GRAVEYARD_TO_HAND_RE` (Raise Dead's
  "... to your hand.") that this file's own gap survey had missed - is now
  `_RETURN_FROM_YOUR_GRAVEYARD_TO_BATTLEFIELD_RE` /
  `return_ability_targets_to_battlefield`, covering **Unearth**, **Renegade
  Rallier**'s Revolt ETB, and **Tameshi, Reality Architect**'s `{X}` activated
  ability. Reanimating **Renegade Rallier** end to end also needed a second,
  independent fix: `machines/triggers.intervening_if_holds` had no reader for
  Revolt's own intervening-*if* wording ("a permanent left the battlefield
  under your control this turn") - CR 207.2c's ability word was enforced for
  Fatal Push's *target-restriction* reading of Revolt
  (`comparison_value_if_revolt`, `test_fatal_push_revolt.py`) but never for a
  *triggered ability's* intervening if, which is a different code path
  entirely, so Renegade Rallier's ETB failed closed and recorded an
  `InterveningIfNotice` even with Revolt genuinely active - now read by
  `_REVOLT_CLAUSES`, sharing `Game.revolt_active_for` with the existing
  reading. `_MASS_RETURN_FROM_GRAVEYARD_TO_BATTLEFIELD_RE` also gained an
  optional trailing " tapped" (CR 110.5b), covering **Aftermath Analyst**'s
  "Return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped."
  **Persist** (the sorcery) is the fifth card of this same template and is
  deliberately not covered - see the "Not modelled" table's own row, which
  explains why its trailing "with a -1/-1 counter on it" is a CR 614.1c
  enters-with replacement rather than another instance of this shape.
- **Reading a *card's* description, as opposed to a permanent's.**
  `_parse_card_group_qualifier` is the new counterpart to
  `_parse_mass_type_qualifier`: a card in a graveyard, hand or library has only
  its printed characteristics (CR 400.7), and no computed board to ask. It
  reads CR 205.2a's card types, CR 110.4a's "permanent card" group, a negated
  CR 205.3 subtype ("non-Avatar creature card"), and a CR 202.3 mana-value
  bound. `_parse_card_group_alternatives` splits an "A or B" list of them.
- **Mass return to hand.** `_parse_mass_return_to_hand_clause` for
  **Sunderflock**, plus the printed plural "to their owners' hands" added to
  `_RETURN_TARGET_RE`, which is all **Marang River Regent** was missing.
- **A bounce that asks who controlled the permanent.**
  `_parse_return_target_then_conditional_draw` for **Boomerang Basics**: the
  controller check has to run before the return, because a card in a hand has
  no controller at all (CR 108.4).
- **Explore** (CR 701.44a-d) - the primitive is `_explore`: the reveal is
  CR 701.20a; the "back on top or into your graveyard" half reuses `Game.
  look_at_top_and_split` rather than `Game.surveil`, since nothing here is
  CR 701.25a's keyword action. `_parse_explores_then_conditional_mass_
  destroy` is **Amalia Benavides Aguirre**'s own whole trigger (her second
  sentence, "Then destroy all other creatures if its power is exactly N.",
  with the power compared *after* the +1/+1 counter the explore may have
  just added, CR 122.1a, CR 613.4c). T08 added the generic clause,
  `_parse_explores_clause`: "`<subject>` explores[, then it explores
  again]." off any triggered, activated, or spell text, subject one of
  "this creature"/"this permanent" (a literal self-name normalizes to this
  first, `_self_normalized_effect_text`)/"it" (a self-reference, gated to
  abilities only - CR 300.1: a resolving spell is never itself a permanent),
  "target creature you control", or "each creature you control" (built for
  generality; no Modern/Pioneer/Standard-legal printing carries this exact
  wording yet, so it has no scenario proof). Registered twice in
  `_parse_mixed_clause`'s and `_parse_mixed_clauses`' shared per-clause
  dispatcher (reached by spells, triggered abilities, activated abilities,
  and a modal spell's own chosen-mode text alike): once against a clause's
  whole, unsplit text (catches the "again" doubling, which `_CLAUSE_
  SEPARATOR`'s bare ", then " would otherwise cut into two unreadable
  fragments) and once per ordinary clause (a plain "it explores." sharing a
  card with an unrelated second clause, Enter the Unknown's own extra land
  drop). CR 701.44c ("gone before this resolves, its last known information
  says which object explored and who controlled it") reads `AbilityOnStack.
  source_or_last_known` rather than `.source` - the same one-line fix now
  applied to Amalia's own dedicated parser too, since her trigger had the
  identical bug (stopped exploring entirely, rather than exploring with no
  counter, the moment her own source left the battlefield). Several
  permanents from one instruction (CR 701.44d) go one at a time in APNAP
  order, `_explore_each_in_apnap_order`; every subject this parser reads
  names at most one permanent, so that branch is implemented and unit-level
  correct but likewise has no real multi-explorer printing to prove it
  against (`o:explores` on Scryfall returns none). Proven live on **Merfolk
  Branchwalker** (plain ETB "it explores": land, nonland-keep,
  nonland-graveyard, an empty library, and the permanent bounced in response
  to its own trigger), **Jadelight Ranger** (explores twice: land then
  nonland, two nonlands), **Legion Vanguard** ("this creature", an activated
  ability), **Miner's Guidewing** ("target creature you control", a death
  trigger), **Enter the Unknown** (a sorcery, alongside an unrelated second
  clause), and **Over the Edge** (a modal sorcery's second mode, the
  "again" doubling on a targeted subject).
- **Recruit** (CR 701.70a) - `_parse_recruit_clause` for **Lake-town
  Lookout** and **Esgaroth Garrison** (an ETB trigger this time, not a dies
  trigger). The keyword's own definition names the 1/1 white Human Soldier
  token, so it is built here rather than read off reminder text; the "if you
  discarded a nonland card" branch reads what `_discard_cards` actually moved,
  which is why that helper now returns its cards. **Sound the Trumpets**
  prints a second shape, "Counter target spell. If that spell's mana value
  was 2 or less, recruit." - CR 400.7 anaphora gating the keyword action
  rather than a bare "Recruit." clause, read by
  `_parse_counter_then_recruit_by_mana_value_pair` as the clause *pair* it
  is, reusing `_parse_recruit_clause`'s own effect once the threshold holds.
- **Sacrificing N of a group** (CR 701.21a) - `_parse_sacrifice_n_of_a_group_
  clause` for **Lotus Field**. Which permanents is CR 608.2d's choice among
  the controller's own; fewer than N on the battlefield sacrifices all there
  are rather than failing.
- **Tokens created already attacking** (CR 508.4, CR 508.4c) -
  `_parse_attacking_token_clause` for **Parhelion II**. Untapped, unlike
  CR 508.1f's declared attacker; the defender is read off the attack the
  trigger's own controller already declared, the same reading Dalkovan
  Encampment's tokens already take.
- **A count that depends on what paid the cost** - **Witch's Oven**'s "if the
  sacrificed creature's toughness was 4 or greater". CR 602.2b pays an
  activated ability's costs before the object on the stack exists, so a new
  `AbilityOnStack.cost_sacrificed_card_ids` carries the choice through, the
  sacrifice twin of the `cost_exiled_card_id` Back from the Brink needed for
  the identical reason. `Game.activate_ability` gained a
  `sacrificed_for_cost=` parameter alongside `exiled_for_cost=`, and the
  scenario harness forwards its own `sacrificing=` into it.
- **Copying your own spell** (CR 707.10, CR 707.10f, CR 608.3f, CR 111.13) -
  `_parse_copy_this_spell_clause` for **Sage of the Skies**' cast trigger,
  routed straight into the existing `Game.copy_spell`.
- **Putting a permanent card from hand onto the battlefield** (CR 110.2a) -
  `_parse_put_permanent_card_from_hand_clause` for **Kona, Rescue Beastie**.
- **Looking at the top N and taking some** (CR 701.20e) -
  `_parse_look_top_lands_take_to_hand` for **Consult the Star Charts** (X is
  CR 107.3c's, defined by the card's own text, and the "if this spell was
  kicked" branch reads the recorded announcement of CR 118.8b's optional
  additional cost off `Game.cast_record`) and `_parse_look_top_n_put_total_mv_onto_battlefield`
  for **Michelangelo's Technique**, whose two simultaneous bounds - at most
  two cards, total mana value at most six - are *enforced*: an answer breaking
  either raises rather than being silently trimmed, matching this repo's
  standing rule that CR 608.2d's illegal option is refused, not corrected.
  Both bottom the rest in a random order without calling CR 701.24a's shuffle,
  since neither card prints that word.
- **Milling into a choice** (CR 701.17a) - `_parse_mill_then_may_take_from_
  milled` for **Rapid Rescue** (the candidate pool is the cards just milled,
  not the whole graveyard), `_parse_mill_then_may_return_to_hand_clause` for
  **Overlord of the Balemurk** (the hand-destination, multi-description twin
  of Tyvar's existing battlefield one), and `_parse_mill_then_play_that_card`
  for **Tablet of Discovery** (CR 601.3's permission over the graveyard).
- **Exiling the top and being allowed to play it** -
  `_parse_exile_top_then_play_until_next_turn` for **Interdimensional Web
  Watch**, reusing `PlayPermission.expires_end_of_next_turn`.
- **"Unless you discard a `<quality>` card"** (CR 118.12a) -
  `_parse_draw_then_discard_unless` for **Winternight Stories**.
- **Doubling a creature's power** (CR 701.10a, CR 701.10b, CR 701.10c) -
  `_parse_double_power_target_clause` for **Mightform Harmonizer**. The value
  is fixed as the ability resolves and the resulting layer 7c effect
  (CR 613.4c) never recomputes.
- **A mana ability whose amount is devotion** - **Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx**'s
  second ability is now read as what CR 605.1a says it is: an activated mana
  ability, which CR 605.3b keeps off the stack entirely. `machines/abilities.
  py` gained `ManaAbility.amount_from_devotion` and `resolve(count=...)`; the
  count itself is CR 700.5's devotion, computed by `Game.activate_ability`
  through the newly-public `machines/effects.devotion_to` (the body lifted out
  of `_devotion_count`'s closure, unchanged). Its leading "Choose a color."
  sentence is stripped before the "Add ..." one is read, because that choice
  is the same `color` argument every `any_color` ability already takes.
- **`each opponent loses N life`** (CR 119.3, CR 102.2) added to
  `parse_clause_effect`'s player clauses - **Cauldron Familiar**'s enters
  trigger.
- **A "Sneak `<cost>`" line** (CR 702.190a) stripped by
  `_strip_non_effect_preamble`, alongside the flashback and harmonize lines it
  already stripped. It is a way to cast the card, not part of resolving it,
  and left in place it sank Michelangelo's Technique's whole paragraph.

One targeting fix came out of the same batch: `machines/targeting.py` used to
elide "creature" after any bare subtype word, so "target Vehicle card from your
graveyard" (Greasefang's own) required `Type.CREATURE` and no Vehicle card in a
graveyard could ever be a legal target. The elision now only happens when no
explicit noun follows the subtype.

### W15's second half: the gaps the scenario tests exposed

Closing the effect side left five cards still doing nothing in a real game,
because their *trigger* never fired or their copy never became anything. Each
was found by writing the scenario, not by reading the sweeper:

- **A triggered ability printed on a card in a graveyard never fired at all.**
  `Game.emit` only ever offered the battlefield (plus the stack for a cast
  trigger, plus the object that just left for CR 603.10a's look-back events) as
  trigger sources, so Arclight Phoenix's combat trigger was unreachable.
  Graveyard cards are offered now, and `machines/triggers.
  zones_ability_functions_in` reads CR 113.6m - "An ability whose cost or
  effect specifies that it moves the object it's on out of a particular zone
  functions only in that zone" - off the ability's **effect** text, which is
  where Arclight Phoenix names the zone. The zone filter in `triggers_for` is
  what keeps this from widening anything else: every other ability still
  answers "battlefield" and a graveyard card is dropped exactly as before.
- **Three intervening *if* clauses failed closed** (CR 608.2a), which looks
  identical to a card doing nothing: "you've cast three or more instant and
  sorcery spells this turn" (Arclight Phoenix), "you've cast another spell this
  turn" (Sage of the Skies), and "Kona is tapped" (Kona, Rescue Beastie). All
  three are read now - the first two off `Game.spells_cast_this_turn`, the
  third off the source's own tap state, with CR 201.5/201.5c's
  self-reference-by-printed-name handled so "Kona" means Kona, Rescue Beastie.
- **"At the beginning of your second main phase" matched no step.**
  `_STEP_PHRASES` knew "postcombat main phase" and "first main phase" but not
  the other name CR 505.1 gives the same phase.
- **A copy of a permanent spell resolved into a second real card.**
  `Game.copy_spell` set `CardState.is_copy` and nothing ever read it, so Sage
  of the Skies' copy arrived as a card-backed permanent. CR 707.10f/CR 111.13/
  CR 608.3f make it a token as it resolves, and `Game.resolve_top` now sets
  `CardState.token` at exactly that moment - not at copy time, since while it
  is on the stack it is still a copy of a spell. Nothing is "created", so no
  token-creation replacement effect applies, which is why this sets the flag
  rather than routing through `create_tokens`.
- **A spell's own "you gain N life" emitted no life-gain event.** The parsed
  clause called `Player.gain_life`, which adjusts the total (CR 119.3) but
  skips `Game.gain_life`'s emit - so CR 119.9's "Whenever a source causes [a
  player] to gain life" was blind to every spell in the pool, and only lifelink
  ever triggered it. Amalia Benavides Aguirre is the card that exposed it; Soul
  Warden, Guide of Souls and Ocelot Pride were equally affected.

One targeting fix rides along: `machines/targeting.py` elided "creature" after
any bare subtype word, so Greasefang's own "target Vehicle card from your
graveyard" required `Type.CREATURE` and no Vehicle card in a graveyard could
ever be legal. The elision now stops when an explicit noun follows the subtype.

**Still not modelled, and named here rather than papered over:** crew
(CR 702.122a) has no execution path, so a Vehicle never becomes a creature on
its own - `tests/scenarios/test_tokens_created_attacking.py` animates Parhelion
II with Karn, the Great Creator's `+1` to reach its attack trigger, and says so.
And the toughness Witch's Oven reads off the sacrificed creature is the printed
one: CR 400.7 leaves nothing else on a card in a graveyard for this engine to
read, so a creature sacrificed while wearing a +1/+1 counter bakes by its
printed toughness.

## Attached-creature statics, qualified anthems, and CR 400.7 in the layer engine

Three closures in `machines/layers/`, on one pass. Every CR number here was
looked up with `knowledge_search(q="...", type="rules")` in the session that
wrote it, and every card's text with `resolve_cards` or straight off its
fixture.

**"Enchanted creature ..." joins "Equipped creature ...".** CR 301.5a names the
equipped creature; CR 303.4b names the enchanted one ("The object or player an
Aura is attached to is called enchanted"). Both are `CardState.attached_to`, so
`_EQUIPPED_CREATURE_STATIC_RE` became `_ATTACHED_CREATURE_STATIC_RE` and reads
either word. Five printings stopped being silent: Rancor, Hyena Umbra,
Detective's Phoenix, Umbral Mantle, Unable to Scream. The Monster Role token's
`LAYER_EFFECTS` row went with it - CR 111.10k states the token's text in full
and it is the same sentence Rancor prints.

Two shapes rather than one, because Unable to Scream is not the pump:

- `_ATTACHED_CREATURE_STATIC_RE` - "gets +N/+N [and has \<keywords>]", "has
  \<keywords>", and now `has "\<quoted ability>"`. Sublayer 7c (CR 613.4c),
  layer 6 (CR 613.1f), one ability across two layers (CR 613.6).
- `_ATTACHED_CREATURE_LOSES_AND_BECOMES_RE` - Unable to Scream's "loses all
  abilities and is a Toy artifact creature with base power and toughness 0/2 in
  addition to its other types", which writes layer 6, layer 4 (CR 613.1d with
  CR 205.1b) and sublayer 7b (CR 613.4b) at once.

**A quoted granted ability reaches `Game.activated_abilities`.** CR 113.10a:
"An effect that adds an activated ability may include activation instructions
for that ability. These instructions become part of the ability that's added to
the object." The layer-6 grant puts the line into the computed characteristics,
which is not where `Game.activated_abilities` looks - that reads
`CardState.granted_ability_texts` through `granted_activated_abilities_of`. So
`sync_granted_ability_texts` runs on every battlefield sweep (`static_effects`
and `ContinuousEffects.all_effects`) and **reconciles** that list rather than
appending to it, which is what makes an unequip take the ability back off
(CR 604.2). `_QUOTED_GRANT_VOCABULARY` remembers every text this mechanism has
seen a permanent offer, so a *source leaving the battlefield* can still have its
grant removed - nothing on the battlefield prints it any more at that point.
A line put there by anything else (Urza's Saga's chapter II grant, a resolved
one-shot) is never touched.

**Qualified anthem subjects.** `_QUALIFIED_CREATURE_SUBJECT` is one fragment
shared by `_ANTHEM_RE` and `_INDEFINITE_KEYWORD_GRANT_RE`: `[other]
[non<colour>] [land] creature[ token]s [you control|your opponents control]`,
with an optional `_BOARD_COUNT_GATE_RE` ("As long as you control N or more
\<card type>s, ") in front. Every qualifier is a predicate inside the
`Selector` (`qualified_creatures`), never a stored `Duration` - CR 611.3a: a
static ability's effect "isn't 'locked in'; it applies at any given moment to
whatever its text indicates", so the colour test and the land count are re-asked
on every CR 613.5 computation. Two more shapes landed with them:
`_OTHER_CREATURES_ARE_TYPE_RE` (Ygra, Eater of All - layer 4 type-and-subtype
grant reaching every creature, plus a quoted ability) and `_ALL_COLORS_RE`
(Leyline of the Guildpact's second line - layer 5, CR 613.1e).

Six printings stopped being silent: Angel of Jubilation, Caretaker's Talent
(its level-3 paragraph, still gated by CR 716.2a's own level check through
`CardState.class_ability_text`), Fecund Greenshell, Aang, Destined Savior,
Leyline of the Guildpact, Ygra, Eater of All.

**CR 400.7 in every target-fixed effect.** Every builder that fixes an effect to
a resolving spell's or ability's target used `_only(target.id)`, an id-only
selector. `CardState.id` is stable across a zone change, so a creature that
died and came back was still being pumped by the Giant Growth that resolved on
the one that died - wrong under CR 611.2c ("the set of objects it affects is
determined when that continuous effect begins") read together with CR 400.7
("An object that moves from one zone to another becomes a new object with no
memory of, or relation to, its previous existence"). All sixteen call sites now
use `only_this_incarnation(target, target.zone_change_stamp)`, the selector
earthbend already proved. `tests/scenarios/test_continuous_effects_with_a_
duration.py::test_a_creature_that_died_and_returned_is_not_the_pumped_one` was
an `xfail` for this and now passes; its sibling
`test_two_durational_effects_apply_in_the_order_they_were_created` was quietly
relying on the bug (it computed a board for a creature already in the graveyard)
and was rewritten around a creature that survives both spells.

Scenario coverage: `tests/scenarios/test_attached_creature_statics.py`,
`tests/scenarios/test_qualified_anthems.py`.

**Still silent, and named rather than papered over:** Caged Sun's "Creatures you
control of the chosen color get +1/+1" needs a chosen colour recorded on the
permanent (CR 105.4's choice). Keen-Eyed Curator stood beside it until S09 read
its linked-exile threshold (see that section); Gavony Dawnguard's day/night
text (CR 731) replaced it as the sweeper's control in `tests/test_sweep_pool.py`
and `tests/test_survey_cards.py`, which used to be Rancor and Angel of
Jubilation, until S29 built day and night; the control is now chosen from
the pool at test time.

## Number words: one shared count reader (number sweep G0)

Every count a card prints is read by `magic_cards_model/numbers.py`: "a"/"an",
"zero" through "twenty", the tens to "fifty", digits including "1,000" (CR
107.1: "The only numbers the Magic game uses are integers"), CR 107.3's X and
"X, where X is ..." as a `VariableX` marker, "once"/"twice"/"thrice"/"N times",
the ordinals "first" through "twentieth", and quantifiers ("up to N", CR
107.1c's "any number of", "one or more", "that many") as a `Quantity`. The
fourteen tables that used to live in `machines/effects/`, `machines/cost/`, `machines/casting/`,
`targeting.py`, `modes.py`, `companion.py`, `abilities.py` (two), `machines/triggers/`
(two), `machines/replacement/`, `machines/layers/`, `models/game/` (two) and `models/deck.py` are
gone, and investigate's multiplier reads `parse_multiplier`. Most tables
stopped at "ten", so a card printing "thirteen" did nothing.

Proven on off-pool printings: Army of the Damned ("Create thirteen tapped 2/2
black Zombie creature tokens") and Archive Trap ("Target opponent mills
thirteen cards") in `tests/scenarios/test_number_words_beyond_ten.py`; the
reader itself in `tests/test_numbers.py`.

**Fails closed now.** The replacement reader split "enters with that many
+1/+1 counters" into an unknown count word and took CR 107.3m's X for it, with
a made-up counter kind. A word that is not a count now makes the sentence
`UNPARSED` (the "your choice of a flying counter or ..." lines) unless it is
"[`<multiplier>`] that many" itself, which the "As this enters, sacrifice any
number of ..." pairing below now reads - see the Modelled table's own row
(Shimatsu the Bloodcloaked, Devouring Hellion). The six whole-card parsers
that captured `\w+` and raised `KeyError` on an X (The Darkness Crystal,
Turntimber Symbiosis, Atraxa, Nashi, Dalkovan Encampment, Guide of Souls)
capture a count only.

**Still not read, and not number gaps:**

| Gap | Card | Where |
|---|---|---|
| "Each opponent mills N cards" is unread for any N | Fractured Sanity | `machines/effects/` player clauses |
| "Tap N untapped <quality> you control" as an activation cost has no chooser: `Game.activation_cost` fills only EXILE and REVEAL object costs | Persistent Petitioners | `models/game/_activation.py` `activation_cost` |
| "You may pay {B} rather than pay this spell's mana cost if there are N or more creatures on the battlefield" | Blasphemous Edict | `machines/casting/` conditional alternative costs |

## G14: card-name rows and whole-card literal parsers (number sweep)

Nine of G14's parsers read a count through `numbers.py` (so a future card
sharing the exact template with a different count would read for free) but
are, today, proven on only the one real printing whose shape they read - a
full-text Scryfall search (`https://api.scryfall.com/cards/search?q=o:"..."`,
run 2026-09-14) for each shape's own distinctive phrase turned up no second
real printing with a different count. That is the honest state, not a gap:
`CLAUDE.md`'s no-mocks rule bans a hand-typed sentence standing in for a
card's own printed words in a test, so nothing here is tested against a count
these parsers were never actually asked to read from a live card.

| Parser | Card | Search phrase | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| `_parse_hideaway_counter_then_conditional_free_cast_clause` | Fight Rigging | `o:"then if you control a creature with power"` | 1 (itself) |
| `_parse_search_mv_equal_to_sacrificed_clause` | Neoform | `o:"additional +1/+1 counter" o:"plus the sacrificed"` | 1 (itself) |
| `_parse_put_land_from_hand_repeat_clause` | Cultivator Colossus | `o:"put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield" o:"repeat this process"` | 1 (itself; Zimone and Dina shares "repeat this process" but a different shape - draws first, repeats only once, conditionally) |
| `_parse_draw_then_put_land_cave_bonus_clause` | Spelunking | `o:"if you put a cave onto the battlefield this way"` | 1 (itself) |
| `_parse_remove_time_counter_from_self_clause` | Greater Gargadon | `o:"remove a time counter from this"` | 6, none saying "this card"/"this permanent" with a different count (Infinite Hourglass, Tourach's Gate, Watcher of Hours, Nihilith, Hourglass of the Lost all say "this artifact"/"this Aura", a different shape) |
| `_parse_discard_then_draw_token_per_nonland_clause` | Seasoned Pyromancer | `o:"for each nonland card discarded this way"` | 1 (itself) |
| `_parse_return_self_then_create_tokens_clause` | Thopter Assembly | `o:"return this creature to its owner's hand and create"` | 1 (itself); the broader `o:"return this creature to its owner's hand"` (72 hits) never combines a return with a token creation on any other card |
| `_parse_switch_power_toughness_then_draw_clause` | Twisted Image | `o:"switch target creature's power and toughness"` | 10, one of which (Inside Out) prints the identical "Draw a card." - a reprint of the same count, not a different one |
| `_parse_delirium_damage_instead_clause` | Unholy Heat | `o:"damage instead if there are four or more card types"` | 1 (itself) |

`_SELF_PUMP_PER_OTHER_CREATURE_NAMED_RE`/`_self_pump_per_other_creature_named_builder`
(the tenth G14 parser, for the `LAYER_EFFECTS["Relentless Rats"]` row) is the
exception with a genuine second printing: Seven Dwarves (`tests/scenarios/
test_named_count_pump.py`), which shares the shape with different wording
("you control" instead of "on the battlefield") and exercises
`CountOtherCreaturesNamed.controlled_by_source`.

## Reality Fracture (fra): Heartwood and the token-creation templates

CR 111.10x adds **Heartwood** to the CR 111.10 predefined-token table - "a red
and green Heartwood artifact token with '{T}: Add {R} or {G}.'" - as a new
row in `models/token.PREDEFINED` (`HEARTWOOD`), read through the same
`predefined_name in PREDEFINED` branch `_parse_token_clause` already uses for
Treasure and Food. Aerid Konstrari, Hungering Puppetbeast, and Tenured
Tethermage each create it off their own printed text with no new parser code.

Four noun-phrase shapes `_parse_generic_token_descriptor`/`_parse_token_clause`
did not read before this wave:

- **"land creature" token** - a second two-type branch beside the existing
  "artifact creature" one, so Verdant Kraken's Forest Tentacle and off-set
  Awaken the Woods' Forest Dryad both read; CR 305.6's basic-land mana
  ability comes free off the token's own "Forest" subtype, no quoted tail
  needed.
- **CR 111.9's named appositive** - "create `<Name>`, a `<descriptor>` token"
  (`_parse_named_appositive_token_clause`), a different shape from
  `_TOKEN_CLAUSE_RE`'s own trailing "named `<Name>`" tail: Jiang Yanggu,
  Never Alone's Mowu and off-set Drizzt Do'Urden's Guenhwyvar. The generic
  descriptor also reads a leading "legendary" supertype now.
- **CR 111.9's own named artifact token with a quoted ability** (Kwia
  Vigorbloom's Lotus) already read with no new parser code - what was
  actually missing was a **CR 603.2h once-per-turn trailer defect**: "...
  with '{T}, Sacrifice this token: ...'.\" This ability triggers only once
  each turn." has the token's own closing quote mark sitting between its
  sentence period and the trailer, which `_ONCE_PER_TURN_TRAILER` in
  `machines/abilities.py` did not tolerate - the whole restriction sentence
  stayed stuck in `TriggeredAbility.effect`, taking the entire clause down as
  unreadable. Fixed to restore the quote mark rather than delete it.
- **Self-copy tokens** - "create N token(s) that('s a copy|are copies) of
  it", gated by a new "it isn't a token" `intervening_if_holds` clause read
  straight off `CardState.token` (CR 603.10a's look-back keeps it set through
  a dies trigger). Sphinx of False Conclusions (dies) and off-set Gruff
  Triplets (enters) both prove neither the trigger nor the parser is fitted
  to one card's wording, and that a token's own copy of itself does not
  re-trigger (it is a token, so its own "isn't a token" reads false).
- **"For each creature target player controls, create a token that's a copy
  of that creature[, except it has `<keyword>`[ and "`<ability>`"]]"** -
  Clone Legion (off-set, no tail) and Face Yourself (on-set, a mixed
  keyword-then-quoted tail neither existing copy-tail reader handled: the
  quoted ability's own internal comma would have been cut by a naive split).
  Read whole, ahead of the per-clause split, the same as the two shapes below.
- **CR 107.3f's own-text X in a token count** - "Create X `<descriptor>`
  tokens..., where X is `<expr>`", through the already-shared
  `count_expression`. `Game` gained `life_gained_amount_this_turn` (schema
  v21 -> v22), the running-total twin of `life_gained_this_turn`'s boolean,
  for Germinate Recruits' own "the amount of life you gained this turn";
  off-set Charisma Bobblehead's "the number of Bobbleheads you control"
  proves the shape composes with an already-supported magnitude too.
- **"If this spell was cast from a graveyard, put counters on {that
  token|each of them}[ for every N cards in your graveyard]"** - read off
  `Game.cast_record(spell).origin_zone`, already recorded for every keyword
  cast including flashback. Recursive Recruitment's own divisor ("for every
  three cards in your graveyard") and off-set Retrieve the Esper's flat
  count both read, cast from hand (no bonus) and from the graveyard (bonus).
- **"Create ... token named X, then put a counter on each other `<subtype>`
  you control"** - Command the Stage. `_parse_put_counters_on_group_clause`
  gained its own, different "other" (excluding an *ability's* own source,
  proven off-set on Summon: Good King Mog XII's Saga chapter IV); Command the
  Stage's own "other" excludes the tokens the same sentence just created
  instead, which needed a dedicated combined parser
  (`_parse_create_tokens_then_counter_other_subtype_clause`).

Command the Stage also carries a second, independent paragraph - "At the
beginning of each upkeep, ... return this card from your graveyard to your
hand." (CR 112.6c, an ability that functions from the graveyard) - printed
below its own spell effect. `Game.resolve_top` reads a resolving spell's whole
`oracle_text`, so that second paragraph used to poison the first one's own
resolution too (CR 608.2c's no-half-effect discipline, applied to two
*different* abilities concatenated by accident). `effect_for` now calls
`_strip_trailing_standalone_triggered_ability`, which peels off a trailing
paragraph only when it is this specific, widely-templated (25+ real
printings) "return this card from your graveyard to your hand" shape - not
"any paragraph that happens to parse as one complete ability": Summoner's
Pact's own second paragraph also parses as one complete triggered ability and
is genuinely part of the spell's own resolution (the delayed pay-or-lose
trigger it creates), and a broader rule silently dropped it, caught by the
full suite before this landed. The graveyard-functioning ability itself
(reading and executing a trigger while its card sits in the graveyard) is not
built - `docs/engine-coverage.md`'s own gap, not `machines/effects/`'s.

**Left for other streams, same cards:** Heartwood Crafter, Konstrari
Improviser, and Woodwork Prodigy's shared "Soul Tether" inset spell (also a
plain "Create a Heartwood token.") is reachable only once the `prepare`
layout subsystem exists (S2). Aerid Konstrari's `{6}` activated ability
("Create a Heartwood token. Then Aerid Konstrari gets +X/+0...") and
Hungering Puppetbeast's own "It gains your choice of trample, hexproof, or
haste" both need `effect_for`'s token-clause-then-trailing-grant composition
(S6). Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone's "untap all tokens you control" is a group
static this wave does not read (S9).

Scenario coverage: `tests/scenarios/test_token_effect_parser.py`.

## FRA S5: trigger events and per-turn history

Reality Fracture's own "trigger events and per-turn history" stream. Seven new
trigger event shapes (CR 603.2), a general per-turn/last-turn history record,
and three previously-unmatchable trigger conditions closed directly (a
fourth, Gardenize's and Way of the Necromancer's own noncreature-source DIES
gap, was reconciled at the int-engine-dsl merge in favour of a more general
sibling fix - see below).

**New `TriggerEvent`/`ExtraTriggerEvent` shapes, `machines/triggers/events.py`,
`machines/abilities.py`:**

| Condition shape | Event | Emitted from | Card |
|---|---|---|---|
| "Whenever you scry or surveil" | `SCRY_OR_SURVEIL` | `Game.scry`/`Game.surveil` (only when `count > 0`, CR 701.22b/701.25c) | Denzilore Fatehold; off-pool Matoya, Archon Elder |
| "Whenever you activate a loyalty ability" / "an opponent activates ..." | `LOYALTY_ABILITY_ACTIVATED` | `Game.activate_ability`'s loyalty branch | Ajani Unrelenting, Gideon the Oathless |
| "Whenever you put one or more loyalty counters on a planeswalker" | `ExtraTriggerEvent.COUNTERS_PUT` (unread-condition path, `_LOYALTY_COUNTERS_PUT_ON_PLANESWALKER_CONDITION`) | Already emitted generically by `Game.add_counters`; only the condition parser was missing | Inspired Tethermage |
| "This creature is dealt damage" / "an/one or more opponent(s) [is/are] dealt [non]combat damage[, during your turn]" | `DEALS_DAMAGE`, recipient side (`GameEvent.target_id`/`target_controller`/`target_types`, alongside the existing dealer side) | `Game.deal_damage` | Hexhaven Invigorator, Master of Barbs, Massacre Girl Most Wanted, Fblthp Impossibly Lost; off-pool Bellowing Aegisaur, Wildfire Elemental |
| "When you discard this card" | `DISCARDS_A_CARD` self-reference (`GameEvent.discarded_ids`, the whole batch one discard instruction moved) | `Game.discard_cards`; `zones_ability_functions_in` gained a branch since a discard trigger can never occur on the battlefield (CR 113.6k) | Titanbones, Towering Heart; off-pool Edgar's Awakening |
| "Attacks alone" (CR 506.5) / "attacks a player alone" (CR 506.6) | `ATTACKS` (`GameEvent.attacking_alone`/`attacking_player_alone`) | `Game.declare_attackers`, now registering every attacker of a declaration before emitting any of their events (previously one at a time, which settled "alone" off a partial party) | Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. (off-pool), Jiang Yanggu Alone, Yuriko Blade of the Mighty |
| "Until end of turn, whenever [self] deals combat damage to a player, draw N cards" | Granted delayed trigger (`machines/delayed.DelayedTrigger` gained `combat_only`/`to_player_only`) | `machines/effects._parse_until_end_of_turn_self_combat_damage_draw_clause`, matched against the CR 201.5-normalized self-reference, not the literal card name | Lyra, Tolarian Archangel |

**General per-turn history**, rather than one more single-purpose `Game`
field per fact: `Game.turn_facts`/`turn_facts_last_turn` (`record_turn_fact`/
`turn_fact_holds`, a fact name to the set of players it is true for) and
`Game.graveyard_arrivals_this_turn` (`GraveyardArrival`, one entry per card
that reached a graveyard this turn, with its origin zone and whether it was a
permanent card as it left the battlefield - shaped to answer a Descend-style
"permanent cards put into graveyards this turn" as well as this stream's own
"from a library"). Wired into `intervening_if_holds`/`Game.condition_holds`:
Kiora of Salt and Sand's "activated a loyalty ability this turn", Roiling
Canopy's "at least five other Forests", Darklight Phoenix's "two or more
creatures died this turn", Command the Stage's "dealt noncombat damage last
turn", and Grim Repriser's "... this turn" activation restriction. This
stream also built its own `Player.life_gained_tally`/`life_gained_tally_turn`
for Germinate Recruits'/Enlightened Confidant's own "the amount of life you
gained this turn" - reconciled at the int-engine-dsl merge in favour of the
fra-s3 line's own `Game.life_gained_amount_this_turn`, which landed
independently for the identical fact and already has `machines/effects/`
reading it; dropped rather than carried forward, one mechanism per fact.

**Gardenize's and Way of the Necromancer's own noncreature-source DIES
gap** ("Whenever a creature you control dies" on an Enchantment, which used
to require "another"/"other" in the text unconditionally before it would
widen past the source's own death) was reconciled at the int-engine-dsl
merge against the num-g0b line of development's own, more general fix to
the identical `condition_matches` DIES branch: g0b's guard widens whenever
the condition is not self-referential at all (`mine`, off `_self_
referential`) rather than checking `_types_match(source.types, condition)`
the way this stream's own first attempt did - simpler, and it also closes
Vein Ripper's and Ygra, Eater of All's own longstanding `unmatchable_
condition` gaps (a *creature* source's plain, self-reference-free "a
creature dies", and a condition naming a subtype rather than a card type,
neither of which this stream's own `_types_match`-gated version could
reach). g0b's mechanism is what `main` keeps; this stream's own version was
dropped. `_required_types` still separately gained plural type-word
matching from this stream (`_plural_type_word_pattern`, `\bcreature\b`
never matched inside "creatures") - not needed for g0b's guard itself, but
still read by the DIES branch's own fallthrough `_types_match(event.
subject_types, condition)` check, so Scavenger's Talent's own "one or more
creatures you control die" now correctly requires the dying permanent to
actually be a creature, not merely widens to match anything.

**Three previously-`unmatchable_condition` `condition_matches` gaps this
stream closed on its own** (`scripts/sweep_pool.py`'s own synthetic prober
could not satisfy any real permanent against them either, which is the
check that found them), off-pool proofs noted:

- **"When enchanted creature dies"** - read `source.attached_to` (CR
  303.4b/303.4m), CR 603.10a's look-back working because the Aura's own SBA
  fall (CR 303.4c/704.5m) has not swept yet when the event fires. Ferocity of
  the Hunt; off-pool Bequeathal.
- **BLOCKS with a power/toughness qualifier** - "a creature ... with power
  [or toughness] N or less/greater blocks" read only the self-referential
  "this creature blocks" forms before; the general form reads the live board
  (`_power_or_toughness_qualifier_holds`, CR 208.1) the same parametrised way
  every other counted condition does. Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer.
  `scripts/sweep_pool.py`'s own probe pool needed real power/toughness-varied
  creatures too (`_cards_by_power_or_toughness`), since its capped five-per-
  type cache is built with no stat in mind.

**`KeywordActivation.why_not` (off-battlefield activation, `machines/
keywords.py`)** never checked a printed "Activate only if <condition>"
restriction (CR 602.5b) at all - only the battlefield path
(`Game.why_cannot_activate`) did. Grim Repriser's own graveyard-functioning
ability could be activated whether or not "an opponent has been dealt
noncombat damage this turn" held. Fixed by reusing `Game.
_activation_condition_holds`, skipped for `rule == "CR 702.62b"` (Greater
Gargadon's own suspend-only restriction, already checked earlier in
`why_not`'s sequence and more precisely via `CardState.is_suspended`).

Scenario tests: `tests/scenarios/test_scry_or_surveil_trigger.py`,
`test_loyalty_ability_activated_trigger.py`,
`test_loyalty_counters_put_trigger.py`, `test_damage_recipient_triggers.py`,
`test_discard_this_card_trigger.py`, `test_attacks_alone_trigger.py`,
`test_granted_combat_damage_draw_delayed_trigger.py`,
`test_dies_trigger_noncreature_source.py`,
`test_enchanted_creature_dies_trigger.py`,
`test_block_power_toughness_qualifier_trigger.py`,
`test_dies_trigger_plural_type_word.py`,
`test_off_battlefield_activation_restriction.py`,
`test_turn_history_predicates.py`.

**Genuine, named gaps this stream leaves open, not silently dropped:**
(Vein Ripper and Ygra, Eater of All, both flagged as still-open in this
stream's own first pass, are closed by the num-g0b line's own DIES fix
instead - see above; `scripts/sweep_pool.py --effects` reports zero
`unmatchable_condition` cards pool-wide after this merge.)

- `scripts/sweep_pool.py`'s power/toughness probe only tries the whole pool
  for the *one* qualifier a condition names; a hypothetical condition naming

**Sweep, this merge:** `scripts/sweep_pool.py --effects` moves from 119

the 25 real fixture printings this stream's own `scripts/add_card.py` calls
add to the pool (CR-mandated proof cards, `CLAUDE.md`'s no-mocks rule) - 14
of them are themselves silent, for clauses this stream never owned (Empower
