## 271-tmt integration: removing a counter from a chosen creature as a cost

"{2}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control: Draw a card." (Ray
Fillet, Man Ray; also Korozda Gorgon and Sunstar Chaplain) is a cost whose
counter comes off a permanent the payer chooses as it is paid, not off the
ability's own source. `machines/cost._PHRASE_REMOVE_COUNTERS` reads "from
a(n) <quality> you control" into an empty `REMOVE_COUNTERS` component with a
requirement, `Game._choose_permanent_for_counters` (blight's own chooser)
offers only the permanents the payer controls that meet it and carry enough
of the counters (CR 118.3), and `legal_actions` judges its affordability the
same way before anything is chosen.
`tests/scenarios/test_remove_counter_from_a_creature_you_control_cost.py`.

## 270-ecl T1: Vivid, count/difference amounts, characteristic cost

## reductions, and reveal-until-N-cards

Vivid (CR 207.2c ability word, no rules meaning of its own) prints CR 105.1's
count of colors among a group of permanents its controller controls
(CR 105.2c excludes colorless) in five different amount positions and two
non-amount positions (a CDA and a self cost reduction); `machines/vivid.py`
is new, and it is the one reader every position shares -
`colors_among_count_expression` plugs into `machines/effects/`'s own
`count_expression` (so every "where X is the number of colors among
`<qualifier>` you control" clause already reads it), `costs_less_per_color_
among_reduction` plugs into `models/game/_costs_mana.py`'s `cost_reduction_for`, and the
CDA reuses `machines/layers/parse.py`'s pre-existing `_colors_among_count_factory`
(built for Sisay's/Earthen Ally's own sublayer 7c pump) in a new sublayer 7a
`_COLOR_COUNT_CDA_RE` branch. Three neighbouring templates needed their own
work: `machines/effects._GREATEST_CHARACTERISTIC_AMONG_RE` widened to accept
a creature *subtype* (CR 205.3m) alongside a card type; a new `amount_
expression` term, "the difference between its power and toughness" (always
non-negative - the greater minus the lesser); and a new `CostModifierEffect.
requires_toughness_greater_than_power` field (`machines/cost/`) for a
static cost reduction gated on the spell's *own* characteristic rather than
its type, subtype, or a board count. `machines/triggers/` gained the
non-self twin of its own "this creature attacks or blocks" compound-event
split (`_GROUP_ATTACKS_OR_BLOCKS_RE`): `_trigger_event` reads the first event
word it recognises and stops, so "a creature you control attacks or blocks"
was read as ATTACKS alone and the "or blocks" half silently dropped.

## 270-ecl T3: -1/-1 counter self-removal, mass placement, dies-with-counter return, persist grants, can't-have-counters-put-on-it

Lorwyn Eclipsed's own -1/-1 counter and persist family, closed with one new
module, `machines/minus_counters.py` (registered additively into `machines/
counter_effects.parse_resolution_text`'s own `_WHOLE_TEXT_READERS` tuple, so
nothing in `machines/effects/` had to change beyond one new `_parse_mixed_
clause` dispatch call reaching the identical module for a modal spell's own
bullet, which never goes through the whole-text path at all - see the table
row below), plus two new static shapes in `machines/layers/` and a fix to
two shared helpers the granted-persist shapes exposed as broken.

The self-removal family's own trigger conditions - "while `<this>` has a
`<kind>` counter on it" as an intervening *if* (CR 603.4) or an event
qualifier (CR 603.2), and "it had a `<kind>` counter on it" as a dies
trigger's own look-back (CR 603.10a) - were **already** fully generic before
this task: `machines/conditions/objects._has_counters` already read any
"`<subject>` has/had `<quantity>` `<kind>` counter(s) on it" clause, both as
an intervening *if* and as an event qualifier. Every card below needed only
the *removal* half.

| Mechanic | CR | Reader | Reported card | Off-pool proof | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| "Remove a[n]/`<n>` `<kind>` counter(s) from this creature/permanent/artifact/it." with no "if you do" and no "you may" - the bare, unconditional self-removal every "while it has a counter" trigger above needed | 122.5 | `minus_counters._parse_remove_a_counter_from_self_clause` | Bristlebane Battler, Reluctant Dounguard, Encumbered Reejerey, Moonshadow, Creakwood Safewright | Belligerent Hatchling (a cast trigger with no "while it has a counter" gate at all) | `test_minus_counter_self_removal.py` |
| "`<any clause>`, then remove a `<kind>` counter from this creature/it." - the leading clause reads through the ordinary single-clause resolver (`effects._ability_effect_or_notice`), so a leading surveil, damage, or any other independently-resolvable clause reaches this the same way | 122.5, 608.2c | `minus_counters._parse_then_remove_a_counter_from_self_clause` | Heirloom Auntie ("surveil 1, then remove a -1/-1 counter") | - (covered by scenario coverage of the removal with and without a counter present rather than a second printing; see MEMORY.md) | `test_minus_counter_self_removal.py` |
| "Return it to the battlefield under its owner's/your control and it loses all abilities." - a dies trigger's return, CR 400.7's new object, and a fresh layer 6 removal (`layers.lose_all_abilities`, reused not reimplemented) on that new incarnation | 603.10a, 400.7, 613.1f | `minus_counters._parse_return_self_loses_all_abilities_clause` | Retched Wretch | - (no second legal printing of the exact combined sentence; the two primitives it glues are each independently precedented elsewhere already - Enduring cycle's return, Humility's loses-all-abilities; see MEMORY.md) | `test_dies_with_minus_counter_return.py` |

Two shared-helper fixes the granted-persist shapes exposed, both regression-checked against the pre-existing `test_indefinite_keyword_grant.py`/`test_typed_group_keyword_grant.py`/`test_type_add_and_keyword_grants.py`/`test_prowess.py`/`test_persist.py` suites and neither changing behaviour for any caller whose case they did not previously mishandle:

- `layers._indefinite_keyword_grant_builder` now runs its captured sentence through the pre-existing `_source_line_for` before storing it as `ContinuousEffect.source_ability` - the identical fix `_attached_doesnt_untap_builder` already needed for Territorial Kavu, generalised here: a granting sentence whose own printed line carries reminder text (persist's own, folded into Isilu's grant rather than sitting on a separate keyword line) was being compared, by `_still_exists`'s CR 613.6 check, against the wrong (reminder-stripped) string and always came back "gone".
- `triggers.added_ability_lines` now reads `CardState.abilities_as_it_left` (the pre-existing CR 603.10a look-back snapshot `remember_last_known_power_toughness` already took) instead of unconditionally answering `()` once a permanent has left the battlefield - without it, a keyword granted to a permanent by *another* object's static ability could never produce a leaves-the-battlefield trigger at all, since `triggered_abilities_on` builds its granted-candidate list from this function and the departing object's live `computed_characteristics` is already `None` by the time that list is asked for. Filtered against `granted_as_it_left` too, so a *stored* one-shot grant (Rhys's temporary persist, already reconciled onto `granted_ability_texts` before the permanent left) is not counted twice.

`Game.schema_version` is unchanged: `CANT_HAVE_COUNTERS_TEXT` is a plain string value stored the identical way `CANT_BECOME_UNTAPPED_TEXT` already is (inside `Characteristics.abilities`/`ContinuousEffect.modification`, neither a new persisted field), and every other change in this wave is behavioural, not a new field on `Game` or `CardState`.

## 270-ecl T2: Blight as an effect (every position), opponent blights, the blighted-creature reference, and the enters-or-transforms-into/transforms-and-first-main-phase DFC triggers

CR 701.68's Blight keyword action, read for the first time as ordinary
*effect* text rather than as the cost `machines/cost/` already reads
(Sting-Slinger's "Blight 1:", Requiting Hex's "you may blight 1" additional
cost - both untouched). New `machines/blight_effects.py` owns every position:

- Forced "blight N." (Shadow Urchin's own attack trigger) and its spell twin
  (the tail of Dose of Dawnglow's "Then if it isn't your main phase, blight
  2.").
- The general CR 118.12 "you may `<action>`. If you [do|don't], `<conse-
  quence>`." shape (`parse_may_action_then_branch_clause`) - one reader for
  every position blight prints this way (Blighted Blackthorn, Boggart
  Mischief, Sourbread Auntie, Dream Seizer, Scuzzback Scrounger, Gutsplitter
  Gang, Chaos Spewer's "pay `{2}`, else blight" reversal), plus any other
  card sharing the shape (Mardu Woe-Reaper, no blight in sight) - deliber-
  ately tried only as the *last* resort in both `_ability_effect_or_notice`
  and `_parse_mixed_clause`'s own dispatch chains, after every narrower "may
  ... if you do/don't" reader, so it only ever runs on a shape none of those
  already read.
- The CR 603.12 reflexive "you may blight N. When you do, `<consequence>`."
  twin (Warren Torchmaster).
- CR 701.68c's "the blighted creature" reference (Grub, Notorious Auntie's
  own attack trigger), reusing the landed copy-token-with-exceptions reader
  (`effects._read_token_copy_except`) and CR 508.4's put-onto-the-battlefield-
  attacking primitives.
- "each opponent blights N" (High Perfect Morcant) and "target opponent
  blights N" (Champion of the Weird's own activated ability - its cost,
  "Pay 1 life, Blight 2:", is `machines/cost/`'s existing life-payment and
  blight-as-a-cost reading).
- A targeted grant of a quoted *triggered* ability (Sygg, Wanderwine Wisdom)
  and CR 702.16h's "protection from each color" (Sygg, Wanderbrine Shield),
  both hand-built `ContinuousEffect`s through `layers.grant_ability` - the
  same escape hatch Iron Fist's and Ms. Marvel's own granted-quoted-ability
  readers already use, since `LAYER_EFFECTS` has no row for either shape.

The enters-or-transforms-into trigger (CR 701.27e, CR 712.18: transforming is
not a new object) and its rarer "transforms into `<face>` and at the
beginning of your first main phase" combined-event twin needed two condition/
effect-splitter fixes in `machines/abilities._parse_triggered`
(`_enters_or_transforms_into_face_boundary`, `_transforms_into_face_and_
first_main_boundary`) - several ecl legends print a face name with its own
internal comma ("Ashling, Rekindled"), which the plain top-level split cut
through - and one new `triggers._expand_transforms_and_first_main`, wired
into `triggered_abilities_of`/`granted_triggered_abilities_of` the same way
every other compound-condition `_expand_*` splitter already is. Proven on
Ashling, Rekindled // Ashling, Rimebound; Brigid, Clachan's Heart // Brigid,
Doun's Mind; Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie; Sygg,
Wanderwine Wisdom // Sygg, Wanderbrine Shield; Trystan, Callous Cultivator //
Trystan, Penitent Culler; and Brutal Cathar // Moonrage Brute (Modern/
Pioneer-legal, outside this pool, a face with no internal comma).

The mana-value spend restriction Ashling, Rimebound's own combined trigger
prints ("Spend this mana only to cast spells with mana value 4 or greater",
no card-type qualifier at all) needed no new code - `models/mana.SpendClause.
min_mana_value` and `machines/cost._SPEND_CAST_CLAUSE` already read an
untyped restriction correctly; proven for real (not only parsed) here and on
a second printing, Troyan, Gutsy Explorer (Modern/Pioneer/Standard).

`tests/scenarios/test_blight_positions.py`, `test_opponent_blights.py`,
`test_blighted_creature_copy.py`, `test_enters_or_transforms_into.py`,
`test_spend_restricted_mana_mv.py`.

Champion of the Weird's own casting cost, "As an additional cost to cast this
spell, behold a Goblin and exile it." (CR 118.8/601.2f's one object, two
verbs), is closed here too: `_PHRASE_BEHOLD` now reads an optional trailing
"and exile it" and `CostComponent.exile_after` makes `pay`/`unpay` move the
beheld object through `Game.exile_cards` exactly like an ordinary `EXILE`
component, whichever zone it was beheld from (hand or battlefield).
`total_cost_for_phrase` tries a comma-free phrase whole before falling back to
its "and"-splitting path, so "behold a Goblin and exile it" is read as one
component rather than split into an unreadable "behold a Goblin" plus "exile
it" - the general fix for any single-component cost whose own text contains
an internal "and" (Champion of the Clachan's "behold a Kithkin and exile it"
shares the shape). `test_opponent_blights.py`'s
`test_casting_champion_of_the_weird_pays_behold_and_exile` and
`test_casting_champion_of_the_weird_beholds_a_battlefield_goblin` prove it
end-to-end, both hand and battlefield beholding.

Layers per CR 613.1a-g; base power and toughness in sublayer 7b (CR 613.4b);
a resolving effect with no duration lasts until the end of the game (CR
611.2a); keyword counters are layer 6 grants at their own CR 613.7c
timestamps (`ContinuousEffects.keyword_counter_grants`, `keyword_counter_stamps`),

put on before it does not (CR 613.1f). One instruction that puts several
permanents onto the battlefield - a token creation, a mass reanimation - is

## 270-ecl T6: bare-subtype target pumps, tapped/attacking-status group
statics, entered/attacked-with-N-this-turn counting, put-onto-battlefield
with a dynamic mana-value cap, reflexive tap-then-reanimate, dynamic-X
anaphor pumps, an equipped/enchanted-creature CR 701.14a fight, and an
Equipment's own singular toughness-damage-assignment grant

Sixteen Lorwyn Eclipsed cards revive old Lorwyn-block templating
(`_SUBTYPE_TARGET_PUMP_RE`'s bare creature-type target noun) and add a
per-turn *count* ledger alongside the pre-existing per-turn *fact* one
(`Game.turn_counts`/`LayerContext.turn_count`, the counting twin of
`turn_facts`/`LayerContext.has_turn_fact`). `Game.declare_attackers` and
`Game._announce_entry` now write both ledgers side by side wherever they
already wrote the boolean one; `LayerContext` gained `tapped_ids` (CR 110.5,
the tapped-status twin of `attacking`) and `entered_this_turn_ids` (the
per-object identity check "another creature entered" needs that a bare count
cannot answer on its own).

(`effects._SEARCH_AND_PUT_RE`'s "into your hand" family and

pipeline they share) only ever read a ceiling ("or less"), so the clause
failed to match at all and fell through to no effect and no notice - the
"unrelated silent clause" MEMORY.md never mentioned when Conduit of Ruin was
substituted in as this task's proof card.

## EC7-rv-rules: cast-trigger X after countering, name-then-reveal ordering, an attach-fails rider, an "up to N" real choice, and card-name validation

An independent rules-defect review of this branch. Every fix generalises the
mechanic; three of the readers involved are proven, and remain, on a single
in-format printing each - documented here per this project's own "narrow,
documented exception" rule rather than left silently asserted.

- **Cast-trigger X survives the spell being countered in response.**
  `machines/triggers.GameEvent` gained `subject_stamp` (schema 101): the
  cast spell's own `zone_change_stamp` at the moment its `CAST_SPELL` event
  was raised. `effects._cast_trigger_record` (read by `_cast_trigger_x_
  value`/`_cast_trigger_mana_spent_x_value`) now finds the spell by id,
  answers directly while it is still on the stack, and otherwise reads
  `CardState.last_known_spell.cast_record` - the copy `Game.forget_cast_
  record` preserves there before dropping the live `Game.cast_records`
  entry (CR 608.2h) - falling back to `subject_stamp` only when neither is
  available. Fixes Hydroid Krasis, Genesis Hydra, Old Stickfingers, and
  Geometer's Arthropod alike: `test_cast_trigger_half_x_life_and_draw.py`'s
  `test_countered_in_response_still_gains_life_and_draws_with_the_cast_x`,
  `test_cast_trigger_library_digs.py`'s `test_genesis_hydra_countered_in_
  response_still_digs_with_the_cast_x`.
- **Genesis Hydra's "shuffle the rest" still shuffles at X=0** (Oracle
  ruling: a library is shuffled even when the rest is zero cards, CR
  701.24d) - `effects._parse_cast_trigger_reveal_top_x_put_one_permanent_
  clause` no longer returns before the shuffle tail runs.
  `test_genesis_hydra_x_zero_reveals_nothing_but_still_shuffles`.
- **Conundrum Sphinx's "each player" naming is APNAP-simultaneous, not
  name-then-reveal per player** (CR 101.4) - `effects._parse_each_player_
  name_reveal_branch_clause` now asks every player to name a card, in a
  whole first pass, before revealing or branching for any of them, and the
  miss branch is read generically (Vexing Arcanix's own "puts it into
  their graveyard" alternative to Conundrum Sphinx's "puts it on the
  bottom of their library", proved directly - no second real printing of
  the *group* shape exists; Petra Sphinx is the closest cousin and is not
  legal in Modern, Pioneer, or Standard).
  `test_choose_name_reveal_top_and_branch.py`'s `test_every_player_names_
  before_any_reveal`, `test_generalises_off_a_differently_worded_miss_
  branch`.
- **A chosen card name must be a real card (CR 201.4)** - `Game.ask`'s
  `CHOOSE_A_QUALITY` branch now checks `ChoiceKind.CARD_NAME` answers
  against `data.card_names`, Scryfall's own card-name catalog of the whole
  CR 108.1 Oracle card reference (bundled by `scripts/add_card_names.py`),
  and the bundled printings pool for a card newer than that catalog. Applies to every
  "choose a card name" question in the engine, not only Vexing Arcanix and
  Conundrum Sphinx (`_ask_name_reveal_top_and_branch` and the pre-existing
  "as this enters, choose a card name" grants - Runed Halo, Pithing Needle,
  Disruptor Flute - now go through the identical check).
  `test_an_invalid_name_is_refused`, `test_a_real_but_unbundled_card_name_
  is_also_refused`.
- **Hidden Blade's rider still applies when the attach itself fails**
  (CR 608.2c/608.2b: "that creature" is the target already announced going
  on the stack, CR 603.3d, independent of whether the attach later
  succeeds) - `effects._parse_attach_self_then_conditional_rider_clause`
  resolves the target directly off `Game.resolve_targets` rather than only
  through `_attach_self_to_announced_target`'s own all-or-nothing loop,
  which used to return `None` outright - skipping the rider along with the
  attach - the moment the Equipment's own source was gone.
  `test_attach_conditional_rider.py`'s `test_the_rider_still_applies_when_
  the_equipment_is_destroyed_before_its_trigger_resolves`.
- **Clockwork Steed's "up to X" is a real choice, not always the maximum**
  (Clockwork Steed's own 2008-10-01 Scryfall ruling: "you can choose to put
  fewer than X ... counters on it") - a new `DecisionKind.CHOOSE_AN_AMOUNT`
  (`Game.choose_an_amount`), the non-payment generalisation of `PAY_ENERGY_
  AMOUNT`/`PAY_LIFE_AMOUNT`'s own "an int from 0 up to a ceiling" shape,
  asked by `effects._parse_put_up_to_n_counters_on_self_capped_clause`
  instead of defaulting to the smaller of the printed "up to N" and the
  room left under the printed total cap. Clockwork Beast/Avian/Swarm print
  the identical template with a different starting count and cap - none of
  the four is legal in Modern, Pioneer, or Standard, so Clockwork Steed
  stays this reader's only in-format proof; the generality is in the
  grammar (any counter kind, any cap), not a hardcode.
  `test_up_to_x_counters_with_total_cap.py`.
- **Documented one-card shapes** (no second Modern/Pioneer/Standard-legal
  printing found on Scryfall this session, and the reader's own generality
  is in its grammar, not in a second proof): Kozilek, the Broken Reality's
  "up to two target players each manifest two cards from their hands. For
  each card manifested this way, you draw a card." (`effects._MANIFEST_
  FROM_HAND_THEN_DRAW_RE`/`_parse_manifest_from_hand_then_draw_clause`,
  both counts read through the open-ended `COUNT` pattern rather than
  pinned to "two"/"two") and Banish into Fable's "copy it if you control an
  artifact, then copy it if you control an enchantment" two-condition
  shape (`cast_copies._COPY_IT_IF_CONTROL_TWICE_RE`/`parse_copy_it_if_
  control_twice_clause`, both quality words open-ended through `permanent_
  description` rather than pinned to "artifact"/"enchantment"; Mentor's
  Guidance prints a related but genuinely different single-condition,
  multi-type-list "or" shape the regex correctly does not match).


## R0b-T1: conditional enters-tapped lands, bounce/scry/MDFC lands, conditional dual mana

Proof-only for the already-handled readers, one scenario per listed card
(`tests/scenarios/test_r0b_conditional_enters_tapped_lands.py`,
`tests/scenarios/test_r0b_conditional_dual_mana_and_utility_lands.py`):

- Fast lands (Blooming Marsh, Inspiring Vantage, Concealed Courtyard): enter
  tapped from three other lands (CR 614.1d, CR 614.12); slow lands (Shattered
  Sanctum, Stormcarved Coast, Sundown Pass): tapped with zero or one other
  lands. The land never counts itself; opponents' lands do not count.
- Castle Locthwain (a nonbasic Swamp counts; draw then lose life equal to the
  hand size after the draw) and The Lonely Mountain (Equipment; Dwarf ability
  costs {1} less per Equipment, never below {R}; sorcery speed, CR 602.5d).
- Temple of Enlightenment (scry 1, CR 701.22a), Selesnya Sanctuary (bounce
  land, may return itself), Hidden Lair / Gleaming Bastion (coloured mana only
  if entered this turn or a basic land is controlled; {C} always), Fell the
  Profane // Fell Mire (instant; pay 3 life or tapped, CR 712.12, CR 119.4).

Two engine fixes the proofs exposed:

- `Game.activation_cost_reduction_for` now reads a **subtype** quality ("for
  each Equipment / Island / Shrine you control", CR 205.3) - it previously
  recorded a `CostModifierNotice` and reduced by nothing. Second printings:
  Waterbending Scroll (Island), Sanctum of Tranquil Light (Shrine).
- `CardState.turn_entered` is now stamped and compared as
  `TurnMachine.turns_taken`, not `turn_number` (rounds): "entered this turn"
  no longer stayed true through the opponent's turn of the same round.

## R0b-T7: landfall and counter doubling, sacrifice and discard payoffs, protection tricks, becomes-target triggers

Twelve cards, each proven through the engine (`test_r0b_landfall_and_counter_doubling.py`,
`test_r0b_sacrifice_and_discard_payoffs.py`,
`test_r0b_protection_tricks_and_target_triggers.py`): Mossborn Hydra, Sapling
Nursery, Sakura-Tribe Scout, Gene Pollinator; Biotech Specialist, Cryogen
Relic, Iron-Shield Elf, Monument to Endurance; Kami of False Hope, Snakeskin
Veil, Surrak, Elusive Hunter, Emberheart Challenger. Three real gaps were
found by the proofs and closed:

- **A subtype subject names every permanent with that subtype, not only
  creatures** - Sapling Nursery's "Treefolk and Forests you control gain
  indestructible" (`effects` mass-subtype subject reader) now reaches the
  Forests (CR 205.3i land types) as well as the Treefolk (CR 205.3m); it used
  to filter on `is_creature` first and silently skipped every land. No second
  Modern/Pioneer/Standard printing carries a land- or artifact-type subject
  list (searched on Scryfall); the existing creature-subtype subjects
  (Along the Crooked Way) are the unchanged regression proof.
- **A Lander token is a Lander artifact** - CR 111.10u is now a
  `models/token.PREDEFINED` row (`LANDER`), so the token carries the Lander
  subtype (CR 205.3g); proven on Biotech Specialist and on Sami's Curiosity
  (a spell that creates it rather than an enters trigger).
- **Becomes-the-target triggers with an "or" subject, and spells on the
  stack as targets** - Surrak, Elusive Hunter's "a creature you control or a
  creature spell you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an
  opponent controls" was classed handled but never fired
  (`triggers._OBJECT_TARGET_SUBJECT` read exactly one object). The subject
  now joins alternatives with "or", an alternative saying "spell" names an
  object on the stack and one that does not names a permanent, and
  `Casting._emit_becomes_target`/`Game._emit_ability_becomes_target` raise
  the event for a spell on the stack too (a counterspell's target). The
  general "a player or permanent" condition (Loki) ignores a stack object.
  Battle Mammoth ("a permanent you control") is the second-printing proof
  that a permanent-only condition does not see a countered creature spell.

## 293-fra T7: pre-release fixture refresh

190 `set:fra` printings were fetched before release with every legality `not_legal` (so `in_target_formats` dropped them and no sweep ever ran them); Gallia, the Merrymaker and Stingcaster Mage also carried outdated oracle text. All were re-fetched from Scryfall (the 38 cards owned by T1-T6 and Proft, Sinister Mastermind excluded), which put 189 cards into the Modern/Pioneer/Standard pool and exposed what the sweep had never measured.

| Mechanic | CR | Where | Proof |
|---|---|---|---|
| An enters-the-battlefield trigger that refers to X, on a permanent put onto the battlefield rather than cast, resolves with X = 0 (it used to crash resolving an unresolved amount) | CR 107.3b, 107.3m | `Game._etb_x_effect_text(..., uncast_x=0)` on the resolution side | `scenarios/test_uncast_etb_x.py` (Ajani's Anguish, Mutagen Man, Living Ooze) |
| Current oracle wording of Gallia, the Merrymaker ("with a +1/+1 counter on it") and Stingcaster Mage (flashback reminder text) | CR 702.10a, 702.34a | fixtures | `scenarios/test_fra_fixture_refresh_wording.py` |

Sweep drivers added (no engine change): "whenever you / an opponent activates a loyalty ability" (a probe planeswalker's loyalty ability, on the opponent's own turn for the opponent) and the "if you've activated a loyalty ability this turn" history (Ajani Unrelenting, Gideon the Oathless, Kiora of Salt and Sand); "you may remove a counter from this creature" stages the counter (Guiding Hydra is a 0/0 that otherwise dies, CR 704.5f); "a creature an opponent controls with <quality> blocks" puts the probe on the opponent's side as the blocker (Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer); "cast a prepared spell" prepares a prepare creature and casts its exile copy (Codie, Ravenous Codex); "an opponent has been dealt noncombat damage this turn" history (Grim Repriser).

## EP01-R1-T3: block-count, block-only and lure statics

Read by `machines/block_statics.py` off every battlefield permanent's computed abilities (CR 613.5); credited by `static_audit/block_count.py` only when those same parsers read the line.

| Mechanic | Where | Cards | Scenario |

| "`<subject>` can block an additional creature each combat", "an additional `<n>` creatures", "any number of creatures", "for each Equipment attached to `<it>`" (CR 509.1a): bound per blocker is 1 + every applying grant, summed; self, "equipped creature", "each creature you control [with a +1/+1 counter on it]" | `block_statics.blocks_allowed` / `multi_block_refusal`, called from `combat.declaration_refusal` | Foriysian Interceptor, Spike-Tailed Ceratops, Watcher in the Web, Kemba's Legion, Palace Guard, Echo Circlet, High Ground, Brave the Sands, Cenn's Tactician | `scenarios/test_ep01_r1_extra_blockers.py` |
| A blocker blocking two or more attackers divides its combat damage as its controller chooses (CR 510.1d); unscripted default is lethal to each in declaration order, the rest on the last | `combat._blocker_assignment` (`ASSIGN_COMBAT_DAMAGE` decision with the blocker as damager) | Spike-Tailed Ceratops | `scenarios/test_ep01_r1_extra_blockers.py` |
| "All creatures able to block `<subject>` do so." (CR 509.1c): one requirement per creature able to block the lure creature; tapped, "can't block" and evasion-excused creatures are not able; the maximum obeyable decides (a blocker serves one lure unless it may block more; a menace lure needs its blockers together) | `block_statics.unobeyed_lure_requirement` (declaration), `required_lure_declaration` (unscripted default) | Breaker of Armies, Elvish Bard, Prized Unicorn, Lure, Nemesis Mask, Noble Quarry | `scenarios/test_ep01_r1_lure.py` |

## EP01-R1-T5: static damage prevention and damage replacement (CR 615.1, CR 614.1a, CR 616.1, CR 120.4)

`replacement/prevention_statics.py` reads a damage paragraph whole or not at all (object-phrase grammar + event clause + outcome + riders); `static_audit/damage_replacement.py` credits a line only when it reads. Against damage that can't be prevented (CR 615.12) a prevention prevents nothing and amount-referring riders get 0, other riders still happen.

| "Prevent all [combat\|noncombat] damage that would be dealt to / by / to and dealt by `<object phrase>`" (enchanted/equipped creature, you, creature tokens you control, attacking creatures you control, other attacking Soldiers you control, creatures with first strike, creatures blocking it, sources with the chosen name; "During your turn") | `prevention_statics._read_prevent_all` | Defang, Temporal Isolation, Candletrap, Heart of Light, Ghostly Possession, Emmara Tandris, Iroas, Dolmen Gate, Rescue Retriever, Light of Sanction, Solitary Confinement, Personal Sanctuary, Gideon Blackblade, Uncle Istvan, Tresserhorn Skyknight, Armored Transport, Gideon's Intervention | `scenarios/test_ep01_r1_prevent_all_damage_static.py` |
| "Prevent all damage that this creature would deal to `<group>`" | `prevention_statics._read_prevent_all` | Goblin Furrier, Indentured Oaf | same |
| "If `<source>` would deal [non\|combat] damage [to `<recipient>`], it deals double / twice that much / half that damage rounded down / that much plus N (or plus the fire counters) instead" (CR 701.10g) | `prevention_statics._read_if` / `_read_outcomes` | Goldnight Castigator, Curse of Bloodletting, Gisela, Charging Tuskodon, Fire Servant, Obosh, Neriv, Kuja (Trance Kuja), Ghosts of the Innocent, Embermaw Hellion, Pyromancer's Swath/Gauntlet, Valley Flamecaller, Mechanized Warfare, Fated Firepower, Rem Karolus | `scenarios/test_ep01_r1_damage_double_half_plus.py` |

## R0c-T1: self pump "as long as you control a <subtype>" (CR 613.4c, CR 611.3a)

`_SELF_PUMP_WHILE_CONTROLS_SUBTYPE_RE` / `_self_pump_while_controlling_subtype_builder` (`machines/layers/parse.py`) read "This creature gets +P/+T as long as you control a(n) <subtype>." as a layer 7c pump (CR 613.4c) gated by `SelfIfControlsCounted` (threshold 1), re-asked on every CR 613.5 computation so it follows lands entering, leaving or changing type (CR 611.3a, CR 305.7). ### EP-01-R2-T1 additions: grants that reach cards off the battlefield, and spells

- `machines/zone_grants.py`: "Each creature card in your graveyard has unearth {2}{B}", "Each land card in your hand has cycling {R}", "Land cards in your graveyard have dredge 2", "Each creature card in your hand has ninjutsu ...", "Each Sliver card in each player's hand has slivercycling {3}", "Creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield have flash", and the "The same is true for ..." type/colour sentences (Maskwood Nexus, Conspiracy, Celestial Dawn, Mycosynth Lattice). `effective_card(game, card)` appends the granted keyword lines to the printing every keyword reader takes (unearth, cycling, dredge, ninjutsu, outlast, flash), `Game.characteristics_of` applies the layer 4 / 5 parts off the battlefield. CR 604.2, CR 613.1d, CR 613.1e, CR 613.1f.
- Granted keywords with a machine of their own: flanking, exalted (CR 702.83a), frenzy N (CR 702.68a), bushido N (CR 702.45a), absorb N (CR 702.64a, written out as the damage-prevention line), riot (CR 702.136a, counted off the group grant for the entering permanent), outlast (CR 702.107a); `INSTANCE_KEYWORDS` grants add one instance per grant (CR 702.25b).
- Spell grants: freerunning (CR 702.173a; the Assassin half of the condition, commander is not a format here), web-slinging, affinity for any readable quality, rebound (CR 702.88a), ripple N (CR 702.60a), convoke from exile, jump-start (CR 702.133a: graveyard permission, discard as additional cost, exile on leaving the stack).

One reader, `machines/ep02_r1_graveyard_counts.graveyard_count_expression`, answers every "N of the cards in a graveyard" amount; `effects/amounts.count_expression` calls it first for any phrase naming a graveyard, so every consumer of `count_expression`, `_for_each_multiplier` and `amount_expression` (tokens, life, damage, -X/-X, draw, counters, "where X is", "half ..., rounded up") reads it without a card-shaped row.

| "[the] [total] [number of] `<description>` card(s) [named N] [you own] in `<where>`": `<description>` is the search grammar's (types joined by "and"/"and/or"/"or" as a union, "permanent", "nonland", a subtype, a colour); `<where>` is "your graveyard", "all graveyards"/"each graveyard", "that player's graveyard"/"their graveyard" (the first player the resolving ability targets, else its event's player, else its controller), or "exile and in your graveyard" with "you own" (by owner) | 404.1, 108.3, 201.2, 205.2a, 608.2h | `ep02_r1_graveyard_counts.graveyard_count_expression`; the old `_COUNT_CARDS_NAMED_IN_GRAVEYARDS_RE` branch of `count_expression` is deleted (superseded) | `scenarios/test_ep02_r1_graveyard_counts.py` (30 cards, plus Izoni, Kraul Foragers, Revenge of the Rats, Grim Flowering, Growth Cycle, Huskburster Swarm, Nemesis of Mortals, The Mouth of Sauron, Consuming Blob, Souls of the Lost, Crackling Drake) |
